newsitem.title: UK: UK gas interruptions unchanged on Thurs - TransCo.
newsitem.headline: UK gas interruptions unchanged on Thurs - TransCo.

text.p: Gas supply to UK customers holding interruptible contracts will be unchanged on Thursday, British Gas Plc transport arm TransCo announced on Wednesday evening.
As on Wednesday, the following Local Distribution Zones (LDZs) will face full interruption: North Thames, South East, Southern, South West and South Wales.
There will also be Network Sensitive Load interruptions in the following LDZs: Northern, North West, North East, East Midlands and West Midlands.

Gas throughput on Tuesday's gas day, ending at 0600 GMT on Wednesday morning, totalled 374 million cubic metres, compared to a record 388 million cubic metres. Part of this was meeting record electricity demand in England and Wales of 49,730 megawatts at 1700 gmt on Tuesday.

A spokeswoman also said that trade on the flexibility mechanism on Tuesday had seen a system buy of nearly 64 million kilowatt hours (around 2.2 million therms). The average price was 1.3479 p/kWh (around 39.5 pence a therm), but the highest single lot was bought at 1.7061 p/kWh (50 pence a therm).
